# USAFacts

> > USAFacts provides nonpartisan, data-driven analysis of U.S. government statistics, spending, and policy across economy, health, education, crime, and immigration.

USAFacts is a nonpartisan organization founded by Steve Ballmer that aggregates authoritative government data and presents it through interactive visualizations and fact sheets. The site serves as a comprehensive reference for understanding federal finances, social programs, and key policy areas through accessible data journalism.

## Key Topics

- Federal Budget & Spending
- Economic Indicators
- Immigration Statistics
- Crime & Law Enforcement
- Health Insurance & Medicare
- Education Data
- Border Security
- Social Security & Medicaid
- Policy Analysis
- Government Data
- Nonpartisan Facts
- Data Visualization
- Federal Finances
- SNAP & Social Programs
- NATO & Defense

## Core Data Topics

- [US Economy Statistics, Charts, and Trends](https://usafacts.org/economy): Economic indicators, inflation, jobs, taxes, and trade data for US
- [US Government Spending, Budget, and Financing](https://usafacts.org/government-spending): Federal budget, spending analysis, Medicare, Social Security data
- [US Health Statistics, Charts, and Trends](https://usafacts.org/health): Health data including life expectancy, insurance, drug abuse trends
- [US Crime Statistics, Charts, and Trends](https://usafacts.org/crime): Crime statistics, law enforcement data, and prison/jail metrics
- [US Immigration Statistics By Year: Authorized and Unauthorized](https://usafacts.org/immigration): Immigration statistics, border security, visas, and enforcement data
- [US Education Statistics, Charts, and Trends](https://usafacts.org/education): K-12 and higher education data, school funding, teacher pay trends

## Key Reference Articles

- [What is the current inflation rate in the US?](https://usafacts.org/answers/what-is-the-current-inflation-rate/country/united-states): Current inflation rate and Consumer Price Index data analysis
- [How much does the US federal government spend?](https://usafacts.org/answers/how-much-does-the-us-federal-government-spend/country/united-states): Federal spending totals and budget breakdown analysis
- [What is the crime rate in the US?](https://usafacts.org/answers/what-is-the-crime-rate-in-the-us/country/united-states): Violent and property crime rates with FBI data analysis
- [How many migrant encounters are there along the US-Mexico border each month?](https://usafacts.org/answers/how-many-migrant-encounters-are-there-along-the-us-mexico-border/country/united-states): US-Mexico border crossing and migrant encounter statistics
- [How many people are enrolled in Affordable Care Act plans in the US?](https://usafacts.org/answers/how-many-people-are-in-affordable-care-act-plans-in-the-us/country/united-states): ACA enrollment statistics and qualified health plan data

## In-Depth Analysis & Reports

- [State of the Union 2026 Fact Sheet](https://usafacts.org/reports/state-of-the-union/home): Comprehensive 2026 state of union fact sheet with policy analysis
- [Just the Facts: Steve Ballmer and America's Numbers](https://usafacts.org/just-the-facts): Educational video series on government programs and federal budget
- [Which states contribute the most and least to federal revenue?](https://usafacts.org/articles/which-states-contribute-the-most-and-least-to-federal-revenue): State-by-state federal revenue contribution analysis and comparison

## Policy & Defense Topics

- [How many people are in the US military? A demographic overview](https://usafacts.org/articles/how-many-people-are-in-the-us-military-a-demographic-overview): US military personnel statistics and demographic breakdown
- [What is NATO and what countries are members?](https://usafacts.org/articles/what-is-nato-and-what-does-it-cost-to-be-a-member): NATO membership, defense alliance costs, and member countries
- [Is the US a bigger oil importer or exporter?](https://usafacts.org/articles/is-the-us-a-bigger-oil-importer-or-exporter): US oil and petroleum trade data and energy policy analysis

## About USAFacts

- [About USAFacts: Unbiased, Non-Partisan Analysis](https://usafacts.org/about-usafacts): Organization mission, leadership, and nonpartisan data principles
- [Accessible Government Data and Statistics](https://usafacts.org): USAFacts homepage providing nonpartisan government data and statistics

- [In Congress, a single "day" can last 30 seconds or stretch well over 24 hours](https://usafacts.org/articles/congressional-time-in-session): Analysis of congressional session timing and legislative procedures
